solution.description: Reusable document-processing accelerator: stores invoices and receipts in Dataverse, drives them through a status lifecycle, and extracts their contents with AI Builder.

app.name: Document Processing Hub
app.description: Administration and testing surface for the Document Processing Accelerator. Use this app to capture invoice and receipt records, upload a source PDF or image, choose the AI extraction method, submit documents for processing, monitor the processing lifecycle, and read extraction results and processing errors. It deliberately excludes approvals, payments, vendor master matching and accounting posting. Prefer the Document Processing Experience code app when the request is about a tailored end-user browsing experience over the same data.

globalChoices.name: dpa_documentprocessingstatus
globalChoices.description: Shared processing lifecycle for every document type in the accelerator. Automation owns the transitions into Processing, Completed and Failed; users own Draft and Ready to Process.

globalChoices.name: dpa_extractionmethod
globalChoices.description: Which AI extraction approach the processing flow uses for a record. Selected explicitly by the user; never inferred from the document type or file extension.

webResources.name: dpa_documentprocessing.js
webResources.description: Client-side guard for the processing lifecycle: blocks a save that moves a record to Ready to Process without an attached source document, and locks processing-owned fields while a run is in flight. Choice values are resolved by label, never hardcoded.

entities.description: A vendor invoice captured for AI extraction. Holds the uploaded source document, the chosen extraction method, the processing lifecycle state, the extracted invoice values, and the diagnostics of the last processing attempt.
entities.iconDescription: an outlined document sheet with text lines and a currency mark through the middle

primaryAttribute.description: Human-readable label for the invoice record. Use the source filename, or 'Invoice' plus the creation date, when nothing better is known at capture time.

columns.description: The vendor's invoice number. Optional before processing; populated by extraction.
Purchase order the invoice bills against. Populated by extraction when the document carries one.
Legal or trading name of the supplier that issued the invoice.
Full postal address of the supplier, as printed on the invoice.
Supplier tax registration identifier (VAT, GST or equivalent).
Name of the party the invoice is billed to.
Postal address the invoice is billed to.
Date the vendor issued the invoice.
Date payment falls due.
Net amount before tax.
Total tax charged on the invoice.
Gross invoice total including tax.
Balance still payable, which can differ from the total when a deposit was already paid.
Currency the invoice is denominated in, as returned by extraction (CAD, USD, EUR).
The uploaded invoice PDF or image. Required before the record can move to Ready to Process; read by the processing flow.
Where this invoice sits in the processing lifecycle. Users set Draft and Ready to Process; the flow owns Processing, Completed and Failed.
Which AI extraction approach the flow branches to for this record. Chosen by the user, never inferred from the file.
Makes an intentional reprocessing request explicit. The flow resets it to No once a new attempt starts.
When the current or most recent processing attempt began. Set by the flow.
When the most recent processing attempt finished, on success or failure. Set by the flow.
How many times processing has been attempted. Incremented once per attempt; preserved across failures for troubleshooting.
Correlation identifier of the most recent flow run, used to find the run in Power Automate when diagnosing a failure.
Overall confidence reported by the extraction model, 0 to 1. Populated only when a meaningful overall value is available.
Compact JSON of the relevant extraction output, kept for troubleshooting. Diagnostic content, not a primary user surface.
Invoice line items as structured JSON. The MVP deliberately avoids a normalized line-item table.
Short machine-readable failure code from the last attempt. Cleared when a new attempt starts.
User-readable explanation of why the last attempt failed. Cleared when a new attempt starts.
Which extraction path produced the current values, such as Native AI Builder Invoice Model or AI Builder Invoice Custom Prompt.

How the purchase was paid, such as Visa, Cash or Debit.
Net amount before tax.
Total tax charged on the receipt.
Gratuity added to the transaction.
Gross receipt total including tax and tip.
Currency the receipt is denominated in, as returned by extraction (CAD, USD, EUR).

views.name: All Invoices
views.description: Every active invoice, newest first — the default landing grid for the Invoices nav entry.

views.name: Draft Invoices
views.description: Invoices still being prepared. Automation never touches these — a document must be attached and the record moved to Ready to Process first.

views.name: Invoices Ready to Process
views.description: Invoices queued for extraction. A row lingering here means the processing flow did not pick it up.

views.name: Invoices Processing
views.description: Invoices currently being extracted. A row stuck here points at a flow that failed without reaching its error handler.

views.name: Completed Invoices
views.description: Invoices whose extraction succeeded, with the values the model returned.

views.name: Failed Invoices
views.description: Invoices whose extraction failed, with the error to act on. Fix the file or the method, then set the row back to Ready to Process.

views.name: All Receipts

views.name: Draft Receipts

views.name: Receipts Ready to Process
views.description: Receipts queued for extraction. A row lingering here means the processing flow did not pick it up.

views.name: Receipts Processing
views.description: Receipts currently being extracted. A row stuck here points at a flow that failed without reaching its error handler.

views.name: Completed Receipts
views.description: Receipts whose extraction succeeded, with the values the model returned.
